import pytest
from tools import source_case_runner as runner

def test_atomic_first_publication_does_not_overwrite_a_foreign_file_created_after_preflight(tmp_path,monkeypatch):
    output=tmp_path/'race.json';owned={};real_fsync=runner.os.fsync
    def independent_writer_after_preflight(fd):
        real_fsync(fd)
        output.write_bytes(b'foreign-winner')
    monkeypatch.setattr(runner.os,'fsync',independent_writer_after_preflight)
    with pytest.raises(FileExistsError):
        runner.atomic_owned_write(output,b'own-result',owned,root_dir=tmp_path)
    assert output.read_bytes()==b'foreign-winner'
    assert not list(tmp_path.glob('*.writing-*'))

"""ObserverR2 bounded independent race/structural evidence controls."""
from copy import deepcopy
from pathlib import Path
import json
from types import SimpleNamespace

import pytest

from tools import source_case_runner as runner

assert Path(runner.__file__).resolve()==Path('C:/Users/郑曾波/Projects/company-wiki/tools/source_case_runner.py').resolve()


def oracle():
    return [{'oracle_id':'new-opaque-id','original_support_unit_ids':['target'],
             'original_forbidden_context_unit_ids':['previous']}]


def structure():
    return {'sections':[{'section_id':'outer','parent_id':None,'heading_unit_ids':['outer-intro']},
        {'section_id':'current','parent_id':'outer','heading_unit_ids':['new-intro'],'body_unit_ids':['target']}],
        'semantic_units':[{'required_context_by_unit_id':{'target':['qualifier']}}],
        'diagnostics':[{'code':'SOURCE_SCOPE_UNPROVEN','unit_ids':['target','elsewhere']}]}


def test_owned_checkpoint_change_during_flush_is_not_overwritten(tmp_path,monkeypatch):
    p=tmp_path/'checkpoint.json';owned={};runner.atomic_owned_write(p,b'first',owned,root_dir=tmp_path)
    real=runner.os.fsync
    def replace_by_other_writer(fd):
        real(fd);p.write_bytes(b'other-current-owner')
    monkeypatch.setattr(runner.os,'fsync',replace_by_other_writer)
    with pytest.raises(FileExistsError):
        runner.atomic_owned_write(p,b'new',owned,root_dir=tmp_path)
    assert p.read_bytes()==b'other-current-owner'
    assert not list(tmp_path.glob('*.writing-*'))


@pytest.mark.parametrize('fault',['missing','cycle','duplicate','depth'])
def test_ancestry_failure_stays_explicitly_incomplete(fault):
    s=structure();max_depth=32
    if fault=='missing':s['sections'][0]['parent_id']='absent-parent'
    elif fault=='cycle':s['sections'][0]['parent_id']='current'
    elif fault=='duplicate':s['sections'].append(deepcopy(s['sections'][1]))
    else:max_depth=1
    rows,_ids=runner.structure_context_checkpoints(oracle(),s,{'target':object()},max_ancestry=max_depth)
    assert rows[0]['status']=='STRUCTURE_OBSERVED_REQUIRES_SEMANTIC_REVIEW'
    target=rows[0]['support_units'][0]
    assert target['section_paths'] and all(not p['ancestry_path_complete'] for p in target['section_paths'])
    assert target['source_diagnostics']==[{'code':'SOURCE_SCOPE_UNPROVEN','unit_ids':['target']}]


def test_unselected_target_context_excerpts_are_whole_and_not_actor_signoff():
    def unit(uid):return SimpleNamespace(unit_id=uid,source_id='synthetic',source_role='company_filing',raw_text=uid+'完整原文。',coordinates=SimpleNamespace(locator=lambda:'loc:'+uid))
    originals={uid:unit(uid) for uid in ['target','new-intro','outer-intro','qualifier']}
    s=structure();before=deepcopy(s)
    rows,ids=runner.structure_context_checkpoints(oracle(),s,originals)
    excerpt,coverage=runner.excerpt_units_for_checkpoints([],[],[],[],originals,additional_ids=ids)
    assert s==before and ids=={'new-intro','outer-intro','qualifier'}
    assert {row['unit_id'] for row in excerpt}==ids
    assert all(row['raw_text']==originals[row['unit_id']].raw_text for row in excerpt)
    assert coverage['unavailable_original_ids']==[]
    assert rows[0]['status']=='STRUCTURE_OBSERVED_REQUIRES_SEMANTIC_REVIEW'


def test_meaning_context_and_physical_proof_role_are_not_erased_in_receipt():
    meaning=structure();physical=structure()
    meaning['semantic_units']=[{'required_context_by_unit_id':{'target':['previous']}}]
    physical['semantic_units']=[{'required_source_unit_ids_by_unit_id':{'target':['previous']}}]
    originals={uid:object() for uid in ['target','outer-intro','new-intro','previous']}
    a,_=runner.structure_context_checkpoints(oracle(),meaning,originals)
    b,_=runner.structure_context_checkpoints(oracle(),physical,originals)
    (Path(__file__).parent/'role-observation.json').write_text(json.dumps({'meaning_input':meaning,'physical_input':physical,'meaning_output':a,'physical_output':b},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
    assert a!=b, 'Distinct semantic-context and proof-only source roles must remain inspectable'


def test_mandatory_structure_overflow_remains_incomplete_and_declares_loss():
    r={'status':'SOURCE_RETURNED','runtime_unchanged':True,'database_unchanged':False,
       'source_structure_context_checks':[{'oracle_id':'x','support_units':['must-keep-structure'*90000]}]}
    o=json.loads(runner.encode_receipt(r,max_bytes=8192))
    assert o['status']=='OBSERVATION_INCOMPLETE' and o['source_status']=='SOURCE_RETURNED'
    assert 'source_structure_context_checks' in o['unretained_fields']
    assert o['integrity_checkpoints']['database_unchanged'] is False
